For live disclosures use Nasdaq issuer news (view.news.eu.nasdaq.com). iute.com itself returns HTTP 403 to curl (Cloudflare bot block) even with a browser UA; WebFetch renders its HTML pages fine but iute.com-hosted PDFs 403 to curl — use Nasdaq mirror or a real browser session for those.

Scrape the EN/AL site pages and harvest /wp-content/uploads/ PDF links (Reform Agenda, Growth Plan, projects pipeline). NOTE: server does not send the full TLS certificate chain, so WebFetch fails with 'unable to verify the first certificate' — use curl with -k (or supply the CA intermediate). curl -kI the PDF returned HTTP 200 application/pdf (806 KB).

Pull /feed/ (application/rss+xml, HTTP 200) for latest articles; for Bulgaria/payments use the WordPress search feed https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/?s=Bulgaria+payments&feed=rss2 . Avoid scraping the HTML homepage which returns 403 to non-browser clients.

Fetch category pages (/front/category/<id>/) to discover latest release links, then download PDFs from /static/uploads/... (predictable dated paths, e.g. saopstenja for BDP, indeksi_potrosackih_cijena/CPI, spoljna_trgovina, rad, plus bilteni/godisnjak yearbook xlsx/pdf). English versions under /lang/en/. Static, no JS/auth.

download.type: PDF (DESI Bulgaria country profiles, EN/BG, historical 2016-2022)

sources.recommended_method: For narrative reports: scrape/download the DESI Bulgaria country-profile PDFs from the desi-bulgaria and factpages pages (both HTTP 200). For structured indicator values: use the Digital Decade DESI visualisation tool (JS dashboard, JSON-backed) or pull the same indicators from Eurostat's DESI dataset.

Direct PDF asset URLs under /wp-content/uploads/ are downloadable via curl (tested 200 application/pdf, ~5.8MB). HTML listing pages are bot-blocked (403) to datacenter IPs, so discover PDF links via a browser session / residential IP or WebSearch, then fetch the PDFs directly.

Direct PDF download of the CPA reports (tested: HTTP 206, content-type application/pdf via range request). Landing page HTML lists dam/ PDF paths for 2022/2023/2024 editions — parse and fetch directly.

Scrape the raporte-financiare page for .pdf hrefs and download annual public-finance reports (2021-2024) plus financial-difficulty reports. Older PDFs hosted on financat-lokale.al (files.financat-lokale.al).
Poll the RSS feed https://www.jutarnji.hr/feed (HTTP 200, application/rss+xml) and/or scrape the /novac section HTML for business/banking news (A4 market signal).

Fetch PER and other publication PDFs directly from dep.gov.ba/naslovna/ paths; site is ASP.NET (default.aspx) so document list pages use ?id= params. IMPORTANT: server presents a self-signed/untrusted TLS cert, so collectors must disable strict cert verification (curl -k / verify=False).

Scrape the telecom-market-analysis (and telecom-licenses) pages on rak.ba for links into the docs.rak.ba/documents/{uuid}.pdf store; download annual/market-analysis PDFs directly. docs.rak.ba serves application/pdf without auth (tested 2.6MB 2024 report).

Scrape the rubric page for per-year report links (files under https://crc.bg/files/*.pdf); download PDFs. English editions exist for some years (e.g. CRC_AR_2019_EN). Parse postal market analysis PDFs for A4 stats.

Scrape financial-reports page for /uploads/media/speedy_files/*.pdf and *.xlsx links; download quarterly management reports (PDF) and KFN forms (XLSX). Set browser UA — WebFetch is 403 but curl with UA works.

Scrape /o-nama/godisnji-izvjestaji/ for the /media/documents/*.pdf links and download the annual reports directly (HRV and ENG versions available). Stable direct URLs. Re-check yearly for the new report.

Primary: scrape the publications categories on www.rzs.rs.ba (e.g. /front/category/34/) for periodic PDF/Excel bulletins under /static/uploads/bilteni/ (stable direct-download URLs, tested 200). Secondary/manual: the interactive indicators DB at www3.rzs.rs.ba:8080/rzs is a JSF app needing a browser session, so drive it via headless browser or validate manually rather than a plain HTTP fetch.

Download the annual E-Shopper Barometer European report PDF from dpd.com wp-content and parse the Bulgaria section; check geopost.com/en/news each autumn for the new edition URL and per-country extract PDFs.

Download White Book PDFs directly from /wp-content/uploads/ (tested: WHITE-BOOK-2020.pdf, HTTP 200, application/pdf, 2.6MB). Scrape /bijela-knjiga/ page to enumerate all edition PDF links (2007-2020 present). Parse PDF text for banking/finance chapters.

Download the direct wp-content PDF (HTTP 200, application/pdf, ~2.4MB — no registration needed). Also an interactive S3 version at wpr2026digital.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/index.html. For future years, scrape the landing page for the new wp-content PDF link.

Directly download the xlsx files under /var/DATA_<year>/{E1..E6,S1..S6}_<yy>.xlsx (predictable path pattern) and the annual RegionalProfiles<year>.pdf; no auth, no JS. Iterate years via the DATA_<year> folder.

Scrape HTML listing pages: Greece press releases (https://www.deloitte.com/gr/en/about/press-room/press-releases.html) and industry/insights hubs (banking-capital-markets, financial-services, tax alerts). Headlines/links are server-rendered in the HTML, so a plain GET + HTML parse works, no browser session or auth needed. For research reports (Digital Banking Maturity, Regulatory Outlook) follow article pages to linked PDFs and download individually as needed.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML of the hub pages (BCM industry page, /en_gr/technical/tax/tax-alerts, and en_gl EMEIA insight URLs) and follow article links; content is present in HTML (AEM), no auth/JS needed. Use a browser-like User-Agent.

Scrape investors.dieboldnixdorf.com/news-and-events/press-releases (IR platform, year-indexed URLs .../press-releases/news-details/2026/...) or news.dieboldnixdorf.com/press-releases. IR sites usually expose an RSS feed - check for one.

Two-tier: (1) For structured time-series data use the PX-Web databank on port 8083 (databaza.instat.gov.al:8083/pxweb/en/DST/). It is classic ASP.NET PX-Web; the JSON REST API (/api/v1/) is disabled, so table data must be exported via the PX-Web query UI (px/csv/xlsx) driven by a browser/form-POST session - best done with a headless browser. (2) For releases, narrative, methodology and deadlines, scrape static HTML at www.instat.gov.al thematic pages, /en/publications/press-releases and /en/publications/calendar/ (all plain HTML, curl-friendly). Use both /en/ and /sq/ language prefixes.

Scrape the HTML project register at https://www.eib.org/en/projects/loans/index.htm?countries=GR (signed loans) and https://www.eib.org/en/projects/all/ (paginated); also monitor procurement page https://www.eib.org/en/about/procurement/index. No public CSV/JSON export; data.europa.eu EIB dataset distributions merely link back to these HTML pages. All three sample URLs return HTTP 200.

Static HTTP GET scraping. Fetch https://www.payten.com/en/news-events/news/ (nginx, 200, text/html, fully server-rendered — no browser/JS required). Parse article links matching the pattern /en/news-events/news/{slug}/ and follow pagination via ?page=N (?page=2 returns 200). Each article page is plain HTML with title, date and body. Poll periodically for A6 competitor/vendor intelligence. For product/offer pages (e.g. /en/offers/for-merchants/payment-acceptance/, /en/offers/for-payment-financial-institutions/atm-related-services/moneyget-atm-network/) fetch directly, also static HTML.

download.type: PDF/DOC (prospectus and decision attachments linked from issuances and legislation pages)

sources.recommended_method: Scrape with a plain HTTP GET client (curl/requests) sending a real browser User-Agent header — this bypasses the Cloudflare bot rule that returns 403 to WebFetch/default agents. Pages are fully server-rendered, no JS or API needed. Crawl the issuer register at /ucesnici-na-trzistu/emitenti (one page, ~855 rows), then follow each /ucesnici-na-trzistu/emitenti/{code} profile for per-issuer tables. Poll /novosti, /obavjestenja, /finansijski-izvjestaji and /odluke/odobrenja-emisije-vp-javnom-ponudom for A3/A1/A4 updates and parse linked PDF/DOC files. Add polite rate-limiting (one request timed out once; retry logic recommended).

HTTP GET on server-rendered pages: /press (EN newsroom) and /hr-HR/novosti (Croatian news/blog), paginate via ?p=N (e.g. /press?p=1). Also /hr-HR/regulatory-info (A3 regulation) and /about (A1). Content is present in raw HTML, so plain curl/HTTP fetch works without a browser. For job openings (A5), the /careers page renders the list via a Talentlyft JS widget (talentlyftWidget) rather than server HTML, so use the Talentlyft feed/widget or a headless browser for jobs specifically.

Scrape HTML list at https://www.epant.gr/apofaseis-gnomodotiseis.html (EL) or /en/decisions.html (EN), paginating with ?start=N (increments of ~23; 45 pages EL / 16 EN). Follow item links to /apofaseis-gnomodotiseis/item/<id>-*.html to get full decision text and PDF links. Can also filter by year-tag URLs or company tags (e.g. Piraeus Bank). For sector inquiries, download PDF reports directly from /files/<year>/*.pdf. No auth, no JS, no API needed — plain GET + HTML parse.

Scrape static HTML listing https://usa.visa.com/about-visa/newsroom/press-releases-listing.html (headlines+links present in server HTML, no JS needed); follow /about-visa/newsroom/press-releases.releaseId.<ID>.html for full text. No RSS/API exposed.

Scrape the blog index (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/blog -> redirects to /blog-international), the press/newsroom page (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/press, 'More press releases...' link), and localized editions (Bulgarian: https://www.paysera.com/v2/bg/blog-bulgaria; Albania articles under /v2/en/blog/*-albania). Article titles + dates are in server-rendered HTML (curl/WebFetch works on article/blog/press pages). Use a realistic browser User-Agent because the site root returns HTTP 403 to bare curl (bot protection); article and section pages return 200. Career/jobs at /v2/en/career for A5. No RSS feed found.

HTML scraping. Crawl section pages (/finance/, /business, /economics, /company) and tag/company pages (/about/{tag}) which contain article links directly in static HTML (content-type text/html). Paginate with ?page=N (tested ?page=2 -> HTTP 200). Article pages follow /{category}/{slug}.html and are also static HTML. Respect robots.txt crawl-delay: 10s. No auth/cookies/JS needed.

Plain HTML scrape of the bilingual page set: /en/about-us/overview/ (and /hr/), /en/company-data/, /en/merchants-solutions/overview/ and /card-acceptance/acquiring-agreements/, /en/banks-and-financial-institutions/acquiring/atm-solutions/. Static server-rendered HTML, no JS or API needed. Use these for A1 (company profile/management), A6 (vendor/competitor product & acquiring/ATM offering). Note: Nexi Croatia d.o.o. does NOT publish financial statements or annual reports on this site — for A1 financial disclosures collect them from the Croatian court/company registry (sudreg.pravosudje.hr) or FINA rgfi by OIB, not from nexi.hr.

Scrape server-rendered HTML. Recommendations register: GET https://www.synigoroskatanaloti.gr/el/systaseis-porismata?page=N (57 pages, 0-indexed); filter Financial Services via subject-category facet. Each item is an HTML decision page; follow for text/PDF. Annual reports: /en(or el)/annual-report-YYYY pages (2005-2021), PDFs on each report page. News by category: /el/nea?field_category_target_id=3.

Scrape https://www.dieboldnixdorf.com/en-us/newsroom/ (HTML, reachable) or PR Newswire feed https://www.prnewswire.com/news/diebold-nixdorf,-incorporated/ . The investors.dieboldnixdorf.com Q4 IR page is behind a Cloudflare Turnstile challenge and needs a real browser session to reproduce.
Scrape the static HTML newsroom card grid at /newsroom and follow 'Browse All' to the knowledge hub. No RSS/JSON found; periodic HTML scrape. Cloudflare-fronted, /en/global paths 301 to root.

Scrape HTML pages (banke-prihvatitelji, blog, cesto-postavljana-pitanja, en/ mirror) but SET A BROWSER User-Agent — default curl/bot UA returns HTTP 403 (bot protection). With a Mozilla UA pages return 200. Both HR and EN (/en/) versions exist; use /en/blog/ for English content.

Scrape the izvjestaji-emitenta and godisnji-izvjestaji index pages for the dated PDF/XLSX links, then fetch each report file directly over HTTPS (static server, no JS/API needed). Also monitor /saopcenja-i-aktuelnosti/saopcenja1 (press) and /saopcenja-i-aktuelnosti/finansijski-kalendar for A3 deadlines.

download.type: PDF (Visa fact sheet, Visa Direct fact sheets, corporate media kit)

sources.recommended_method: Static HTML scraping of the newsroom and per-country pages (/albania.html, /albania/news.html, /bosnia-n-herzegovina.html). No JS or auth needed. Poll newsroom for new press releases; harvest linked PDF fact sheets. No RSS/API detected.

Scrape each participants page (WordPress) for the linked dated .xlsx (filename pattern YYYYMMDD-RT1-SCT-Inst-Reachable-PSP-List_CUG.xlsx). Download the periodically-refreshed XLSX and parse. Repeat for STEP2 SCT participants page. Filter rows to Greek PSPs (GR BIC/country).

api.auth_needed: Yes - free/limited tier needs API token; higher volume/bulk requires paid plan or data licence

sources.recommended_method: Use OpenCorporates REST API (v0.4) with jurisdiction_code=gr and an api_token for structured JSON; or scrape HTML at /companies/gr. NOTE original sample /registers/88 returns 404 to HEAD but HTTP 200 to browser-UA GET (site blocks HEAD). For authoritative source consider official GEMI at businessregistry.gr / gov.gr GEMI search.
GET RSS https://thefintechtimes.com/feed/ (application/rss+xml). Category feeds also available (e.g. /category/<x>/feed/). Note: wp-json REST API is blocked (403).

Scrape the media-centar listing page (HTTP 200, static server-rendered HTML) with plain HTTP GET; parse dated items and follow individual article links. Filter via on-page categories: Sve novosti / Vijesti / Priopcenja. Poll periodically for new-dated items.

HTTP GET scraping of the stable path pattern https://www.infostock.bg/infostock/control/{section}/{TICKER} where section = quotes | statements | issuenews | institutions | bse. Content is fully server-rendered HTML (no JS/API needed) but encoded in windows-1251 — decode to UTF-8 (iconv -f windows-1251) before parsing. Enumerate issuers via /infostock/control/institutions, then pull quotes/statements/issuenews per ticker.

Scrape the delegation tenders/procurement-planning HTML pages (Albania: /delegations/albania/... procurement-planning pages; BiH: /delegations/bosnia-and-herzegovina/tenders_en) and the central filterable listing https://www.eeas.europa.eu/eeas/tenders_en (filter by Contracting Authority = the relevant delegation). Pages are server-rendered Drupal HTML, curl-fetchable without JS/auth. Delegation tender pages announce negotiated procedures (EUR 15k–143k) via email; the procurement-planning page enumerates the delegation's annual procedures (13 items listed for Albania 2026).

HTML scraping. Content is fully server-rendered (finance category page title 'Financë - Punë aktive - <date>', BKT employer page 'Banka Kombetare Tregtare BKT' both returned in raw HTML), so a plain HTTP GET + HTML parser works without a browser. Crawl /search/category/finance for finance listings and /employers/<slug> for target-employer job activity. No public JSON API or sitemap.xml (404) found; robots.txt exists (200) — respect it.

Plain HTTP GET + HTML parsing (Apache server, HTTP 200, static server-rendered pages, no JS or auth needed). Crawl /propisi/<jurisdiction>/<slug>.html for legal texts, and registar-sluzbenih-glasila.html plus arhiva-sluzbenih-novina-fbih.html for gazette issue links. Content served inline as HTML; poll the register / 'Alarm za glasila' section for new gazette issues.
Scrape section index pages (e.g. /banke/) for article links + dates, then fetch article HTML. RSS probes (/feed,/rss) only redirect to HTML, so use section-list scraping with pagination

Scrape the Greece country page for PDF document links (plan, CID, factsheets, operational arrangements, payment decisions); for structured milestone/target progress use the EC Recovery and Resilience Scoreboard (ec.europa.eu/economy_finance/recovery-and-resilience-scoreboard)

Scrape https://newsroom.mastercard.com/news/press/ (releases grouped by year, reverse-chronological) and follow per-release article pages; use the Europe region filter for EU-relevant items. No RSS/WP/JSON feed exposed, so plain HTML scraping (or WebSearch site: filter).

Scrape the IR sub-sections on eurobank.gr (Financial Results, Presentations, Annual Reports, Press Releases, Financial Calendar) and download linked PDF/Excel files; EL mirror at /el/omilos/enimerosi-ependuton. Old eurobankholdings.gr paths 301 to eurobank.gr - update tracked URLs.

download.type: speech list export / individual speech HTML+PDF

sources.recommended_method: Scrape server-rendered speech index (filter by country/speaker) and individual r*.htm pages; subscribe to BIS RSS feeds (/rss/index.htm) for new speeches, reviews and payment-stats commentaries. For payment statistics use BIS statistics/SDMX data separately.

HTTP GET scrape of /pretraga-poslova with positions= filter (Bankarstvo, plus IT/payments keyword searches), paginate through result pages and parse listing cards server-side (no JS needed). Respect robots.txt (search results allowed; only specific ?source=/utm params disallowed). Optional: subscribe to per-search e-mail alerts as a change signal.

Deloitte has migrated www2.deloitte.com to www.deloitte.com. The old article/tax-alert URLs 301 to generic www.deloitte.com/ce landing pages. For automated collection, crawl the new www.deloitte.com/ce/en (services/insights/research) and country pages (/al, /bg) for banking outlook + tax/legal alert articles, and download linked PDFs from the /content/dam/ DAM. Publicly accessible HTML/PDF, no auth. Refresh saved URLs to the new domain.

ndiqparate.al is a reachable WordPress site (bilingual: ?lang=en for English). Scrape article pages by ?p=<id>, ?cat=<id>, ?tag=<slug>. For structured/bulk data follow to the AIS open-data portals (spending.data.al, openprocurement.al, opencorporates.al) which host the actual datasets and are also HTTP-200; check those for CSV/JSON exports/APIs during the collection phase.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML table at /country/greece (columns: Name, Markets, Developer Portal, Bank Stack, AIS, PIS, APIs). For depth, scrape per-provider pages /provider/<slug> (e.g. atticabank-gr) for API standard (BERLIN), BIC, developer portal URL and API products. No JS or auth needed.
Scrape HTML blog listing at /blog (tag-based) plus /en/press and /case-studies; HubSpot CMS so pages are server-rendered and curl-reachable. Try /blog/rss for a feed.

Scrape HTML pages: /en/pages/about-us, the In-the-Press section, and /en/policies/terms-of-service for product/company intel (A5 early-intent / A6 vendor). No auth, server-rendered enough for WebFetch.

api.params: expert query (e.g. buyer-country=GRC, classification-cpv), fields, page, limit; see TED Developer Portal
api.headers: Content-Type: application/json; API key not required for public search (docs at TED Developer Portal)

sources.recommended_method: Use TED Search API (api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search) filtered to Greece + financial/banking CPV codes; JSON responses, paginate. op.europa.eu page is just a gateway to TED.
Scrape HTML index pages (authors/papers/series); for bulk, harvest the underlying RePEc archives via the RePEc ReDIF/OAI feeds. Server-rendered, no auth.
Scrape the Greece financial-assistance HTML page for PDF links (PPS reports released biannually - spring/autumn); download each new PPS report PDF. No auth. New reports approx every 6 months.

Scrape the EN (and BG) HTML pages: /en (home, date/venue), /en/speakers, plus Partners/Advisory Board/Blog for vendor/competitor (A6) and event-driven (A2/A5) intelligence. Static HTML via GET; note WebFetch is 403-blocked but curl with a Mozilla UA returns full content (uses declarative shadow-DOM templates, but content is in the served HTML).

Fetch the clean-path WebSphere Portal URLs (e.g. /wps/portal/nra/registers-i-spisuci, .../registers, and .../fiskalni-ustroystva-supto-i-e-magazini/... ) with curl -k (or a full CA bundle): the server presents an INCOMPLETE TLS chain, so strict validation fails ('unable to verify the first certificate') - this is why WebFetch errored. Use -k / supply the intermediate cert. Pages are server-rendered HTML (no JS). Ignore the volatile '!ut/p/z1/...' session-token variants and use the readable clean paths. Register detail pages link to downloadable model lists; note approved-model registers are legally maintained by BIM (Bulgarian Institute of Metrology).

Scrape server-rendered HTML of /nabavke-i-pozivi/ and /obavjestenja/; follow 'Vidi arhivu' archive links to enumerate dated notices; fetch linked PDF tender documents. Dropdown filters (value/region/work-type) are light JS enhancement over server content — not required for scraping.

HTML scrape of /en/news (and BG /news) for scheme announcements and of the partners page for the certified-PSP list. Apache serves static HTML 200; both EN and BG versions exist. No downloadable statistics on-site.

Scrape the static HTML service/category pages (/c/51/pagesa payments, /transferta-parash money transfer, /d/82/arketime bill-collection). For fees/tariffs follow the referenced 'Tarifa e Sherbimeve Postare' and 'Lista e Cmimeve' links (likely PDF). For A1/A4 financial reports, search site for 'raporti vjetor'/annual report separately (not on these pages).

Do NOT rely on the authenticated e-albania UseService (service_code 768/770) which needs e-ID login. For A1 company data use the QKB National Business Center public register (qkb.gov.al) - free public search by NUIS/name/shareholder, per-record PDF extracts, and (from May 2025) public beneficial-owners registry. For A2/A4 (tenders, e-payment stats) treat e-albania homepage as an index and follow to APP procurement portal / INSTAT / Ministry of Finance sources. Manual validation needed to confirm QKB search mechanics / any export.

download.type: PDF (annual/sustainability & business reports linked from the annual-reports page)

sources.recommended_method: Use the migrated domain piraeusgroup.gr. Scrape HTML of /en/press-office/news-announcements/ for announcements and /en/investor-relations/annual-reports for annual report PDF links (follow through to per-year PDF URLs). No auth.

Pull the Greece-category RSS feed https://www.electronicpaymentsinternational.com/region/europe/greece/feed/ (200, application/rss+xml). Site-wide feed also at /feed/. Fall back to scraping the HTML region page for older archive items.

Retire the mercury-processing.com source (domain no longer serves content). Collect from Nexi Group site (nexigroup.com newsroom/press, investor relations) and Nexi Croatia (nexi.hr) for careers/clients; these are the live successor sources for the Croatian card-processing entity.
Subscribe to RSS feed https://feeds.feedblitz.com/finovate and scrape keyword search pages (?s=bulgaria, ?s=albania) which are server-rendered with numbered pagination.

Scrape the server-rendered tender list pages (zatvoreni-s145 closed, otvoreni-s144 open) with HTTP GET; parse ~100+ entries with title, start/end dates and PDF links under /storage/upload/natjecaji/. No pagination, single list.
Scrape homepage/product pages with a real browser User-Agent (GET, not HEAD) for A6 competitor/vendor tracking; Cloudflare tolerates normal GET requests with a browser UA.

Scrape static HTML pages with GET requests: /PressCenter for news/press (A6), /content/read/karijera for jobs (A5), /content/read/o-nama for corporate info. IMPORTANT: use GET not HEAD — the ASP.NET server returns a false 404/Error redirect for HEAD requests.

GET the legacy case viewer https://www.aop.bg/case2.php?doc_id=<ID>&mode=show_doc&newver=2 for archived pre-2020 procurement notices; use search UI at www2.aop.bg to enumerate cases. Server is SLOW — use generous timeouts (25s+) and retries. NOTE: live procurement has moved to the successor CAIS EOP portal at app.eop.bg (eop.bg) — use that for current tenders.
Static HTML scrape of easypay.bg/site/ pages (?p=documents, ?p=atm) with query-param routing; EN and BG versions available (/site/en/). No JS needed.

Scrape the homepage and business pages (e.g. /poslovni-korisnici/keks-pay-za-webshop/) for product/merchant/market signals and headline user counts. There is no press/news/investor/API section on this domain — for corporate disclosures, tenders and payment-market statistics (A1/A2/A4), use Erste&Steiermarkische Bank Croatia's corporate/press site and the Croatian National Bank (HNB) payments statistics.

Scrape the single-page HTML (nginx, static) to extract speaker names/titles/orgs, sponsors, and agenda topics. No brochure PDF or API found; content is event-cycle based (currently advertising Balkan Payment Forum, next edition dated May 2027).

HTML scraping of listing pages with URL-based filters (subcategory, city, q-<keyword>) and pagination. Content and JSON-LD ItemList render server-side (curl HTTP 200), so a browser is not required, but the site is behind Cloudflare - use realistic User-Agent and polite rate limiting to avoid challenge pages.

Poll RSS feed https://www.balkanweb.com/feed/ (200, application/rss+xml) for new articles; scrape full article HTML for economy/tech/fintech items. WordPress site, so /wp-json/wp/v2/posts REST API likely also available if richer querying needed.
Static HTML scraping of uet.edu.al pages (news/career-fair, program pages, ECONOMICUS journal). Crawl news section for A5 early-intent signals; parse program pages directly.

Static HTML scrape (Joomla CMS, Cloudflare, HTTP 200). Monitor the news/njoftime and Career Center pages for bank internship/job postings (A5 early-intent) and Finance Department pages (A3/A4). Some PDFs (programs, regulations) linked inline.

Scrape DEI pages (server-rendered Apache, EN + BS) for IPA III/WBIF programming documents, action fiches and regulation PDFs (A2 tenders/A3 regulation/A4 funding). Cross-reference EC enlargement portal for canonical IPA docs.

Scrape section HTML listing pages (biznis/financije, tehnologija/inovacije). Article headlines, dates, authors are in static HTML - no JS needed. No RSS/sitemap/wp-json available; paginate the section pages.

Scrape static HTML listing pages: the Ekonomija section (https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/ekonomija/) and tag pages such as /tag/platni-promet/. Article cards (headline, image, teaser, URL) render server-side; paginate the listing and follow article links. No JS needed.

Scrape static HTML: careers page /en/o-nama/otvorene-pozicije/jobs-about-us (shows vacancies when open; currently generic 'no open positions - send application form'), and news items under /en/vijesti and node pages (/en/node/NNNN). All server-rendered, no JS/auth.

Two options: (1) RSS feed at https://www.poslovni.hr/feed (also /rss) returns application/rss+xml (HTTP 200) - ingest for latest articles; (2) scrape static tag listing pages such as /tag/banke for banking-specific coverage and follow article links. No JS or auth.

Whole domain is behind Cloudflare 'cf-mitigated: challenge' (JS bot challenge) — HTML pages AND /media/*.pdf files all return 403 to curl/WebFetch. Collect via a real headless browser session (Playwright/Selenium with JS challenge solving / stealth, or the claude-in-chrome browser) to render pages and follow media PDF links. Site blocks automated agents (HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch, including with a real browser User-Agent) — anti-bot/JS challenge. Collect via a full headless browser with a persistent real browser session (cookies + JS execution), throttled; some Economedia content is also paywalled. Check for a public RSS feed once a browser session is established (footer/nav) as feeds like on sister sites capital.bg/dnevnik.bg may exist.

Site is behind Cloudflare 'challenge' bot protection (cf-mitigated: challenge, JS/Turnstile). Collect via a real headless browser (e.g. Playwright/Puppeteer with stealth, or the Chrome MCP browser) that executes the Cloudflare JS challenge and holds cf_clearance cookies, then read the procurements/projects tables and any export links from the rendered DOM. No public JSON/CSV API discovered.

Collect via a headless/real browser that solves the Cloudflare JS bot challenge (curl and WebFetch both return HTTP 403). After the challenge, tender listings are plain server-rendered HTML (data embedded in page, not an XHR/JSON API) and can be parsed and paginated (~124 pages). Use the B&H territory filter for Bosnia scope. No login needed for public listings; login only required to post tenders.

Monitor sitemap lastmod for new blog/press posts (A1/A4/A5/A6).
